scenarios.title: Each chosen spree mode happens and the unchosen mode does not
decisions: A casts Caught in the Crossfire choosing only the first mode (2 damage to each outlaw creature), paying {R}{R} plus that mode's {1} by tapping three Mountains.
Both players pass; Caught in the Crossfire resolves.

variants.label: outlaw_only
variants.expected: Assassin Initiate (a Human Assassin, so an outlaw) is dealt 2 damage and moves to A's graveyard in the state-based check. Grizzly Bears is not an outlaw, is not dealt damage and stays on the battlefield. Three Mountains are tapped.

variants.label: non_outlaw_only
variants.delta: A chooses only the second mode (2 damage to each non-outlaw creature) instead of the first.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears is dealt 2 damage and moves to B's graveyard. Assassin Initiate is not dealt damage and stays on the battlefield. Three Mountains are tapped.

variants.label: both_modes
variants.delta: A chooses both modes and pays {R}{R} plus {1} plus {1} by tapping four Mountains.
variants.expected: Assassin Initiate and Grizzly Bears are each dealt 2 damage and move to their owners' graveyards. All four Mountains are tapped.

scenarios.forge_notes: Assassin Initiate's activated ability is never used. Outlaw is implemented as a creature-type group in Forge (Creature.Outlaw).

scenarios.title: The costs of the chosen spree modes are added to the spell's cost
decisions: A, holding priority in the main phase with three untapped Mountains, considers casting Caught in the Crossfire with one mode chosen.

variants.label: one_mode
variants.expected: Casting Caught in the Crossfire with one mode is legal: the total cost is {R}{R}{1}, which three Mountains pay.

variants.label: two_modes
variants.delta: A considers choosing both modes instead of one.
variants.expected: Casting Caught in the Crossfire with both modes is not legal: the total cost is {R}{R}{1}{1}, which three Mountains cannot pay.

variants.label: no_mode
variants.delta: A considers choosing no mode instead of one.
variants.expected: Casting Caught in the Crossfire with no mode chosen is not legal: a spree spell requires at least one mode.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge builds the spree choice as a Charm with MinCharmNum$ 1 and per-mode ModeCost$ values that are added to the spell's cost.
